data.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: vertical 2:3 Pinterest-native editorial base photograph for a later restrained magazine headline
Primary request: Create a composed overhead editorial photograph of the exact Toilet Golf bathroom putting kit from Image 1 laid out for a quiet tournament morning. The small green fairway should first read like a beautifully graphic golf-course shape; the partial white porcelain toilet entering the frame reveals the absurd bathroom use. It must remain a believable real kit in a real bathroom, never a flat poster, collage, or ad.
Input images: Image 1 is the sole product-truth reference. The human is usage context only and must not appear. Preserve the included product components and their scale: one roughly 27-by-31-inch contoured thin green printed fairway mat, one short mini putter with black head and grip plus a red shaft section, one or two ordinary white practice balls, and one small black round practice cup/base with a short black pole and red triangular flag bearing a white circle and simple black numeral 1. Do not add packaging, clubs, scorecards, or course furniture.
Scene/backdrop: clean warm-gray terrazzo bathroom floor, the curved front edge and base of one ordinary white toilet entering naturally from the upper-left, one folded plain white towel barely at the edge. No words, labels, branding, or people.
Subject: the green mat lies flat diagonally from the toilet toward the lower-right. One white ball sits near the toilet end, the black flagged cup at the far end, and the short putter lies alongside the mat at a believable reachable distance. Components cast coherent soft shadows and remain clearly three-dimensional physical objects.
Style/medium: photorealistic contemporary design-magazine overhead photography, tactile, precise, subtle film grain, quietly funny.
Composition/framing: strict vertical 2:3 top-down view; the complete kit fills the center and lower frame without becoming oversized; leave a clean darker terrazzo band in the upper-right for later typography; visually balanced but not a catalog grid.
Lighting/mood: crisp diffuse morning skylight, soft realistic shadows, understated humor.
Color palette: moss and fairway green, warm gray terrazzo, white porcelain, black, and one red flag accent.
Text: no added text, headline, caption, logo, watermark, badge, price, pseudo-writing, or product-card frame. Preserve only the simple numeral 1 on the actual red flag if clean.
Constraints: one toilet edge, one exact kit, no person, body, clothing, packaging, CTA, border, collage, floating product, impossible shadows, or implied included toilet.
Avoid: flat infographic, golf-course aerial landscape, full-size putter, giant green rug, multiple holes, extra balls beyond two, extra flags, warped toilet, malformed club, commercial packshot, generic AI polish.
data.changesFromParent: A deliberately different top-down graphic execution rather than a room-level country-club scene.
notes: Generated separately from the exact source reference and inspected at full useful resolution.
Rejected because the receiving cup reads as a solid display base with a ball perched on it and the overhead arrangement feels more like a product flat lay.
